_comment: Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored. Every other key must be a PresweepConfig field — an unknown one is refused, not ignored, so a typo cannot configure a run nobody chose. Omitted fields take their dataclass defaults. See docs/runbook-orchestrator.md.
_comment_legs: The four-leg configuration (2026-09-03) replaces discovery_languages with the signed policy and turns on the two optional legs; both default false. See docs/runbook-orchestrator.md § The run config.
